def impute_missing_cell(row):
    data = json.loads(row)
    if data["UnitPrice"] is None or isinstance(data["UnitPrice"], float) and data["UnitPrice"] != data["UnitPrice"]:  # Check for NaN
        data["UnitPrice"] = data["Price"] / data["Amount"]
    return [data]
